Summary: We are looking for a talented AI Software Engineer to develop and integrate agentic solutions that help businesses get paid faster and more efficiently. You will work across the stack, fine-tuning models, building AI agents for financial automation, building products and delivering seamless user experiences in a fast-paced fintech startup backed by top investors.
The Role:
We're looking for someone to:

  • Build end to end solutions - this role is not limited at interacting with models, but involves coding in backend/frontend to deliver full functionality to users
  • Build AI agents to intelligently automate finance workflows, suck as bookkeeping, credit control and many others
  • Integrate observability solutions to ensure reliability, cost efficiency and high quality
About You:
Our team is our superpower and we hire only the very best. There is no right or wrong candidate, but from our experience you are likely to have:

  • Experience building AI agents. Experience building AI agents and running them in production
  • 5+ years of experience in backend development at a tech-forward, product-driven company
  • Great software design skills. Amazing at designing the most high performant, scalable and maintainable software solutions
  • End-to-end ownership. Ability to thrive on a high level of ambiguity, autonomy and responsibility. At Adfin we believe strongly in full ownership: from ideation, development, full, testing, releases and operations
  • Quality first mindset, including experience in automating tests
  • Experience with Java is nice to have, however we are open to other languages as long as you are open to learn Java
  • Keen to grow and learn for the long term with a talented group of fellow fintech leaders - and be there at the beginning of the next major global payments success story
Hiring Process:
We try and move fast with hiring whilst giving you and us the chance to make a proper assessment:

  • Initial intros to ensure this is right on both sides (30 mins)
  • Technical interview (2 x 1h)
    • Problem solving mindset - live coding in your favourite programming language
    • Architecture - live design (build diagrams, flows) for a complex problem
  • Final board interview (30 mins)
  • References check on both end - we reference you, you reference us

We always give feedback and try to be as respectful of your time as possible.
The Offer:
• Competitive salary: we pay what it takes to get the best people, but of course at first you can probably earn more in a corporate (but you’ll learn 5% as much and have 1% as much fun!).
  • ‍Equity: everyone at Adfin has meaningful equity, and on terms which are generally more favourable than most startups, which we can discuss with you.‍
  • Office: we value face-to-face collaboration. We are flexible we expect you to spend a portion (2-3 days) of our time in the office near Buckingham Palace (with an exceptional sandwich shop and pub just round the corner and yes - our very own ping pong table).
